messages:
Maya: fyi noticed inconsistency between published Dedicated SLA and telemetry. want quick triage before we push GA badge.
Evan: what numbers are we seeing?
Maya: public doc: 99.95% availability. last 7d: 99.82% for a subset of customers (traffic spikes => p99 errors).
Priya: ouch. that's a meaningful gap. customers expecting reserved capacity guarantees.
Jules: do we have a short mitigation? route offending requests to warm pool or fallback model?
Evan: warm pool helps but affects latency. alternative: automatic retry with jitter + reroute to a lower-cap model for tails.
Maya: decision needed: (A) delay GA until infra fixes (B) ship GA but add an "early-access" SLA caveat + credit policy (C) ship GA with mitigations + publish runbook.
Priya: customers will push back on caveat. finance will want clear credit thresholds.
Jules: ops can enable risk-mode fallback for a few hours. I have a checklist but it's not documented publicly. OpsBot: Runbook draft created -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/sla-fallback-draft :robot_face:
Maya: can someone add the short playbook steps and the exact config toggle to the runbook? we need a snippet for support to run.
Evan: putting snippet here, pls paste into runbook:

```
# enable fallback routing for tail requests
POST /v1/internal/routing/override
Body: {"scope":"dedicated","policy":"tail-fallback","ttl":"60m"}
Header: Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
```

Priya: I'll draft the customer comms and the proposed credit table. looping @finance and @legal.
Maya: timeline: decide by COB Fri. if we delay GA, need a public update and release calendar change.
Jules: I'll add a monitoring alert for p99 >= 0.2% error increase and a dashboard link in the runbook.
OpsBot: Reminder: oncall handoff at 08:00 PT tomorrow.
Maya: thanks. everyone update PRs and post links here when done. we reconvene after the triage notes come in. :thumbsup:
